adaptations: Original skill, authored in this repository (Cookbook) by Rick on 2026-11-25 — not imported from upstream. The checklist topics were prompted by a short-form video ("20 things to have Claude do so your app doesn't get sued"); that list reached us via a search-engine summary rather than a full transcript, so the skill uses checklist topics only, every instruction is written from scratch, and no penalty figures are invented. source.commit records main's HEAD at authoring time; the skill's own history is this repo's history.
description: Runs a pre-launch legal and policy audit over an app or website codebase: policies matched against what the code actually does, consent and data discipline, honesty in marketing and pricing, accessibility basics, and asset rights — audit first with evidence, then fixes one item at a time. Explicitly not legal advice: uncertain items go on a "take to a lawyer" list and penalty figures are never invented.
name: policy
title: Policy
why: The collection's pre-launch conscience: it turns "we should probably check the legal stuff" into an evidence-backed audit an agent can actually run, with guardrails that keep it honest about jurisdiction and uncertainty instead of hallucinating statutes.
